subtitle.zh: 按投入档位看通过率与 token 消耗
subtitle.en: Pass rate against tokens spent, by effort setting

aria.zh: Terminal-Bench 3.0 各投入档位下通过率与 token 消耗的折线图
aria.en: Terminal-Bench 3.0 only: share of attempts that passed against median tokens per attempt, log scale, for Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 5 and Fable 5, with one point per effort setting from low to max. Opus 5.5 scores highest at every setting, from 36.6% at low to 65.7% at max, and Fable 5.1 scores higher than Opus 5 and Fable 5 at every setting. Opus 5.5 at high matches Fable 5.1 at max (58.9% against 58.0%) on half the tokens. Fable 5 levels off at 43.4% from xhigh to max.

caption.zh: 先看每个模型那条线从低档一路走到最高档是不是持续抬升，再比 Opus 5.5 高档和 Fable 5.1 最高档那一对点，纵轴高度几乎一样，横轴却差了一倍。注意横轴是对数刻度，两点之间的水平距离要按比例读。Fable 5 在右侧最先走平，是四条线里最早换不动分数的。
caption.en: Terminal-Bench 3.0, the same 70 tasks for every model (the 4 GPU tasks are left out). Opus 5.5 ran about three weeks later, with responses capped at 128k tokens and no GitHub or PyPI access; Opus 5’s max is its effort-120 run.
